hfs_grade.label: Current hand–foot syndrome (clinician-assessed CTCAE grade)
hfs_grade.assessment_guidance: Assess the current hand–foot syndrome severity. Assess skin changes, pain and limitation of instrumental versus self-care activities. The CTCAE v5.0 hand–foot descriptor is an explicitly labelled UI orientation aid; NCCP 00325 v6 does not specify a grading edition. Reconcile the clinician-assessed grade with the NCCP source action; never silently change source thresholds.
hfs_grade.source_grading_note: NCCP 00325 v6 Table 3 does not specify a CTCAE edition; the explicit v5.0 metadata is an orientation aid, not a claim about the source edition.

hfs_worst_grade.label: Worst hand–foot syndrome grade (clinician-assessed CTCAE grade)
hfs_worst_grade.assessment_guidance: Retain the worst hand–foot syndrome grade for the recorded episode after recovery. Assess skin changes, pain and limitation of instrumental versus self-care activities. The CTCAE v5.0 hand–foot descriptor is an explicitly labelled UI orientation aid; NCCP 00325 v6 does not specify a grading edition. Reconcile the clinician-assessed grade with the NCCP source action; never silently change source thresholds.
hfs_worst_grade.source_grading_note: NCCP 00325 v6 Table 3 does not specify a CTCAE edition; the explicit v5.0 metadata is an orientation aid, not a claim about the source edition.

current_toxicity_grade.label: Current relevant non-haematological toxicity (clinician-assessed adverse-event grade)
current_toxicity_grade.grading_source_label: NCCP 00719 v2 Table 3; grading edition not specified
current_toxicity_grade.source_grading_note: Apply the named adverse event and the NCCP source severity; no CTCAE v5.0 or v6.0 substitution. The generic 0–4 selector is not a complete event-specific grading table.
current_toxicity_grade.assessment_guidance: Record the current grade of the same specific toxicity under review; do not substitute its prior worst grade. Identify the actual adverse event and use its applicable severity criteria with the NCCP source action. Grade 0 means documented absence, not unknown.

prior_worst_toxicity_grade.label: Worst grade of the toxicity that caused interruption (clinician-assessed adverse-event grade)
prior_worst_toxicity_grade.grading_source_label: NCCP 00719 v2 Table 3; grading edition not specified
prior_worst_toxicity_grade.source_grading_note: Apply the named adverse event and the NCCP source severity; no CTCAE v5.0 or v6.0 substitution. The generic 0–4 selector is not a complete event-specific grading table.
prior_worst_toxicity_grade.assessment_guidance: Retain the worst grade of the specific toxicity that caused interruption; do not overwrite it with the recovered current grade. Identify the actual adverse event and use its applicable severity criteria with the NCCP source action. Grade 0 means documented absence, not unknown.

hfsr_worst_grade_this_episode.source_grading_note: Apply the named toxicity and NCCP source severity; no CTCAE v5 substitution. This is not a complete grading table.
hfsr_worst_grade_this_episode.assessment_guidance: Retain the worst hand-foot skin reaction grade of this episode after recovery. Assess painful erythema, swelling, hyperkeratosis, peeling or blistering of palms/soles and the effect on instrumental or self-care activities. Use NCCP Table 2 grades 1–3; grade 0 means documented absence, not unknown. No grade 4 HFSR category is supplied.
